name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A minimal required "Name" text field wiring a label, input, helper description, and a valueMissing validation error message.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — the demo holds no React state; Field.Control is a plain uncontrolled input (no value/defaultValue/onChange) and Field's internal validity state drives Field.Error visibility via match="valueMissing"
nonTrivialInteractions: Field.Root auto-associates Field.Label with the control (clicking the label focuses the input) and links Field.Description via aria-describedby
Field.Error renders only when the native valueMissing constraint matches (empty required input), surfacing once validation is triggered per Field.Root's default onBlur validation mode
